brief:
An explosive device detonated against an Israeli tank operating in Gaza, with no injuries sustained, according to Israel's Channel 12. The Israeli military subsequently launched airstrikes in response to the attack, escalating the cycle of fire between the two sides.

The incident represents the latest in a pattern of armed exchanges occurring in the territory. Channel 12 did not specify the location of the tank strike or provide details on the targets selected for the retaliatory airstrikes. The military response came hours after the initial detonation against the armored vehicle.
